description: This file contains source code for a menu configuration system in C, likely part of a larger configuration or build system such as a kernel or embedded system tool. It defines structures and functions for managing menus, properties, dependencies, and displaying configuration prompts. The code handles hierarchical menu structures, expression rewriting and evaluation, and dependency management.

classes.name: menu
classes.description: Represents a configuration menu or item with hierarchical structure, properties, dependencies, and prompts.

classes.name: property
classes.description: Represents properties associated with menu items, such as prompts, dependencies, and default values.

classes.name: expr
classes.description: Expression object representing logical conditions and dependencies.

classes.name: symbol
classes.description: Represents a configuration symbol or option with associated properties and states.

methods.name: void menu_warn(struct menu * menu,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Outputs a warning message related to a menu item.

methods.name: void menu_add_entry(struct symbol * sym)
methods.description: Adds a new menu entry associated with a symbol.

methods.name: struct:menu * menu_add_menu(void)
methods.description: Creates a new submenu under the current menu context.

methods.name: void menu_end_menu(void)
methods.description: Closes the current menu context, returning to the parent menu.

methods.name: void menu_add_dep(struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Adds a dependency expression to the current menu entry.

methods.name: void menu_set_type(int type)
methods.description: Sets the type of the current menu symbol, with redefinition warnings if necessary.

methods.name: struct:property * menu_add_prop(enum prop_type type,struct expr * expr,struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Adds a property (prompt, default, visibility, etc.) to the current menu entry.

methods.name: struct:property * menu_add_prompt(enum prop_type type,char * prompt,struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Adds a prompt message to the current menu entry.

methods.name: void menu_add_visibility(struct expr * expr)
methods.description: Adds a visibility condition to the current menu entry.

methods.name: void menu_add_expr(enum prop_type type,struct expr * expr,struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Adds a generic expression property to the current menu.

methods.name: void menu_add_symbol(enum prop_type type,struct symbol * sym,struct expr * dep)
methods.description: Associates a symbol with the current menu entry.

methods.name: void menu_finalize(struct menu * parent)
methods.description: Performs final validation and dependency processing on a menu node before finalization.

methods.name: bool menu_has_prompt(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Checks whether a menu has an associated prompt.

methods.name: bool menu_is_empty(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Determines whether a menu contains visible entries or not.

methods.name: bool menu_is_visible(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Determines whether a menu is visible based on its dependencies and parent visibility.

methods.name: const char * menu_get_prompt(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Retrieves the prompt text for a menu.

methods.name: struct:menu * menu_get_root_menu(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Returns the root menu of a menu hierarchy.

methods.name: struct:menu * menu_get_parent_menu(struct menu * menu)
methods.description: Returns the parent menu of a given menu item.

methods.name: void menu_get_ext_help(struct menu * menu,struct gstr * help)
methods.description: Generates extended help information for a menu item.

methods.name: expr_calc_value
methods.description: Calculates the boolean or tristate value of an expression.

methods.name: expr_contains_symbol
methods.description: Checks if an expression contains a particular symbol.
